reason: I already own a couple of paid apps that do the gallery, calculator and fake-call reveals, so Hebrew alone isn't worth 99 ₪ to me. I'd play with the free tricks, but I wouldn't pay until I knew the search trick is actually better than what I have.
objection: It's installed from a browser, not the App Store, so I'm worried it's clunky or breaks after an update, and if the reveal glitches in front of my friends I look like an idiot.
would_change_my_mind: A real video of the search trick working on a stranger's own phone, plus a refund if it doesn't work on my phone.
